fields.notes: The courtesan paid a lakh by Rāmacandra Khān of Benāpola (#1245) to break Haridāsa Ṭhākura's sādhana; by Haridāsa's influence she became a devout Vaiṣṇavī (Kṛṣṇadāsī). Haridāsa Ṭhākura initiated her and told her to do bhajana in his āśrama on the bank of the Gaṅgā; she became a greatly renounced ascetic and saints came from far away to see her (Śrī Navadvīpa-dhāma, p. 207, 234). The record «Lakṣahīrā (Kṛṣṇadāsī)» #824 was joined to this one (12-11-2026).
